headline: RenaissanceRe Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates Despite Catastrophe Losses
summary: Property and casualty reinsurer RenaissanceRe reported third-quarter operating earnings per share above analyst estimates despite facing multiple large loss events during the period.
why: RenaissanceRe is a prominent global reinsurer whose quarterly underwriting performance provides direct insight into catastrophe pricing discipline and global loss trends.

impacts.name: RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd.
impacts.why: Resilient underwriting margins enabled operating profits to exceed consensus despite catastrophe payouts.
